actions.name: line

column.description: The column as a fraction of the width, for a whole-column line.

path.description: Two or more [x, y] points as fractions of the frame, for a path.

width_px.description: The line's full width in pixels of its frame.

in.name: image
in.purpose: The image whose frame the line is in.

out.name: location
out.purpose: The line location.

actions.purpose: A line location: a whole column or a path, with its full width in pixels. When to use: When the region to mask follows a line: the wrap edge at the centre of a cut canvas (column 0.5), a seam, a crease, a scratch that fan will later widen row by row. When not to use: When the mark is a rough hand-drawn stroke to be tightened to the defect (use stroke), or an area (use rect or a polygon).
actions.title: Line

actions.name: rect

bbox.description: [x0, y0, x1, y1] as fractions of the frame; x0 < x1 and y0 < y1
bbox.title: Box

in.name: image
in.purpose: The image whose frame the box is in.

out.name: location
out.purpose: The box as a bbox location.

actions.purpose: A rectangle as a location, from four fractions of the image's frame. When to use: When the region to mask is a known box: a caller's coordinates, a detector's bbox, a plain test shape. When not to use: When the region has a shape (use a polygon or a stroke) or must be found (use a finder).
actions.title: Rect

actions.name: stroke

path.description: Two or more [x, y] points as fractions of the frame.

radius_px.description: The stroke's radius in pixels of its frame.

in.name: image
in.purpose: The image whose frame the stroke is in.

out.name: location
out.purpose: The stroke location.

actions.purpose: A stroke location: a rough mark along a path with a radius in pixels. When to use: When a person or an evaluator marks a scratch, a tear or a thin defect with a brush: the path and radius are the brush. When not to use: When the region is a box or a shape (use rect or a polygon), or a line with a known width (use line).
actions.title: Stroke

actions.name: close

radius_px.description: The disc's radius in pixels of the mask's frame.

in.name: mask
in.purpose: The mask whose core to close.

out.name: mask
out.purpose: The mask with the closed core.

actions.purpose: Closes the core: dilation then erosion by one disc, so gaps and notches narrower than the disc fill in. When to use: On a blob with holes or ragged bites (a segmenter's instance through a chair back, a stroke that skipped). When not to use: To make the core larger overall (use grow) or smaller (use shrink).
actions.title: Close

actions.name: fan

constants.description: The constant set; the first is the default: fan-v3, fan-v1, fan-thin-v1, fan-v2

gate.description: Whether the tone step across the line gates the opening (a row whose sides already agree stays thin).

object_edge.description: The object cap: a horizontal luminance step (levels per pixel) at and above which a column inside the opening counts as a solid object's edge, beyond the seam's own gap; the row stops short of it, and stays thin when edges stand on both sides. 0 turns the cap off.

object_margin_px.description: How far short of an object's edge the band stops, in pixels at ref_width.

ref_width.description: The frame width the pixel constants were fitted at.

row_sigma.description: Row smoothing of the two rulers, as a fraction of the height.

tex_high.description: Texture at and above which the band stays at its minimum width.

tex_low.description: Texture (contrast, percent per pixel) at and below which the surface counts as fully smooth.

thin_px.description: The minimum half-width in pixels at ref_width, scaled by the frame width.

wide_max.description: The widest half-width, as a fraction of the frame width; 0 fixes every row at thin.

width_sigma.description: Row smoothing of the half-width, as a fraction of the height.

in.name: image
in.purpose: The image, in a bounded frame.

in.name: line
in.purpose: The line location in column form, in the image's frame.

out.name: band
out.purpose: The band profile.

actions.purpose: The band profile along a column line: a half-width per row, wide where the surface beside the line is smooth and the two sides differ in tone, thin where it is detailed, and stopping short of a solid object the opening would cross (the object cap, fan-v2; fan-v3 removes a straddling object whole and tapers the cap). When to use: On a cut canvas whose centre column is the wrap edge of a panorama, or any image with a vertical line to heal: the step before profile and ramp. When not to use: When the line is a path or the region is an area (use rasterize); on an uncut equirectangular image (cut it first).
actions.title: Fan

actions.name: feather

constants.description: The constant set; the first is the default: feather-v1

sigma_px.description: The feather's sigma in pixels of the mask's frame.

in.name: mask
in.purpose: The mask whose core to feather.

out.name: mask
out.purpose: The mask with the new blend.

actions.purpose: The blend as a half-Gaussian feather of the core's boundary outward, with one sigma. When to use: On any mask whose edge should fade: a rasterized box, a grown blob, a mask whose core was just replaced by a refinement (the recipe re-feathers afterwards). When not to use: On a band along a line, where the sigma follows the row (use profile).
actions.title: Feather

actions.name: grow

down_px.description: How far down, in pixels, the grown core is extended for a shadow.

px.description: The disc's radius in pixels of the mask's frame.

in.name: mask
in.purpose: The mask whose core to grow.

out.name: mask
out.purpose: The mask with the grown core.

actions.purpose: Grows the core by a disc, and further downward for a shadow. When to use: On a blob that must cover a little more than it was found to (a segmenter's instance, a rasterized shape), and on an object that casts a shadow below it. When not to use: On a band along a line (its width is the fan's), or to soften an edge (use feather).
actions.title: Grow

actions.name: invert

to.description: The target frame: a frame id on the mask's chain, or raw for its root.

in.name: mask
in.purpose: The first pass's mask.

out.name: mask
out.purpose: The second pass's mask, in the target frame.

actions.purpose: The mask for a second pass: everything the first mask reached becomes protect, everything else the core, in the target frame. When to use: After a heal, to edit the rest of the image while keeping the first edit: heal seam then heal protect. When not to use: To shrink or grow a mask (use shrink, grow) or to protect one more thing in the same pass (use subtract).
actions.title: Invert

actions.name: plug

max_share.description: The largest hole filled, as a share of the area of the shape around it.

in.name: mask
in.purpose: The mask whose holes to fill.

out.name: mask
out.purpose: The mask with its small holes filled.

actions.purpose: Fills the core's small holes: every enclosed gap no larger than max_share of the shape around it. When to use: On a mask with gaps inside an object (the leather inside a buckle, a ring's middle), after grow and close, before subtract and feather. When not to use: To keep a large enclosed area out of the mask (a picture inside a frame stays out at the default), or to make the core larger overall (use grow).
actions.title: Plug

actions.name: profile

constants.description: The constant set; the first is the default: profile-v1

feather_ratio.description: The feather sigma of a row as a share of its half-width.

in.name: band
in.purpose: The band profile fan produced.

out.name: mask
out.purpose: The band mask.

actions.purpose: The band mask of a band profile: the core at each row's half-width about the line, the blend a feather whose sigma follows the row. When to use: After fan, to turn its profile into the seam mask that ramp, the filler and paste use. When not to use: On a mask that is not a band along a line (use feather).
actions.title: Profile

actions.name: rasterize

use_case.description: The use case recorded on the mask.

in.name: location
in.purpose: The location to rasterize.

in.name: image
in.purpose: An image in the location's frame, for the frame.

out.name: mask
out.purpose: The mask with the interior as its core.

actions.purpose: A location's interior as the core of a new mask in its frame: boxes and polygons as drawn, a line as a band of its width, a stroke as its path dilated by its radius. When to use: When a location (a box, a polygon, a line, a stroke, the whole image) should become a mask as drawn, before any refinement. When not to use: When the mark is rough and should be tightened to the defect's edges (use tighten), or when the location is a view or absent, which have no interior.
actions.title: Rasterize

actions.name: select

drop.description: The instance indices to leave out.

exclude.description: Boxes, as fractions of the frame, cleared from the core.

keep.description: The instance indices to keep; empty keeps every instance not dropped.

use_case.description: The use case recorded on the mask.

in.name: plane
in.purpose: The instance planes (plane role), in one frame: plane_0, plane_1, …

out.name: mask
out.purpose: The selection as a mask.

actions.purpose: A mask from a finder's instance planes: the kept instances' union as the core, minus exclude boxes. When to use: After segment: to turn its planes into the mask to remove, keeping some instances and dropping others. When not to use: On a single shape (rasterize a location) or to trim a mask (use shrink or subtract).
actions.title: Select

actions.name: shrink

px.description: The disc's radius in pixels of the mask's frame.

in.name: mask
in.purpose: The mask whose core to shrink.

out.name: mask
out.purpose: The mask with the shrunk core.

actions.purpose: Shrinks the core by a disc. When to use: On a mask whose core reaches past what should be repainted: a loose segmentation, a box drawn generously. When not to use: To keep pixels for good (use subtract, which protects them) or to soften an edge (use feather).
actions.title: Shrink

actions.name: subtract

grow_px.description: How far the protected shape is dilated, in pixels of the mask's frame.

in.name: mask
in.purpose: The mask to protect pixels in.

in.name: subtract
in.purpose: A mask whose support (core or blend) becomes protect; in the mask's frame.

in.name: location
in.purpose: A location whose interior becomes protect; in the mask's frame.

out.name: mask
out.purpose: The mask with the larger protect.

actions.purpose: Protects pixels: the second mask's support or a location, grown by a margin, joins protect; core and blend are cleared under it. When to use: To keep something the mask would otherwise repaint: a person in front of the object, a logo, a previous edit. When not to use: To make the core smaller for its own sake (use shrink): protected pixels are kept for good, by every later step.
actions.title: Subtract

actions.name: tighten

constants.description: The constant set; the first is the default: tighten-v1

max_defect_factor.description: The widest defect, as a multiple of the stroke's radius (2 means the whole stroke).

min_contrast.description: The least |g| (luminance levels per pixel) an edge must have to count.

min_defect_px.description: The narrowest defect, in pixels between its two edges.

path_sigma.description: The sigma, in samples, of the smoothing of the tightened extents along the path.

sample_spacing_px.description: The spacing of the samples along the path, in pixels.

in.name: stroke
in.purpose: The stroke location, in the image's frame.

in.name: image
in.purpose: The image the edges are read from.

out.name: mask
out.purpose: The tightened stroke as a mask.

out.name: tightened
out.purpose: Per sample: tightened (0/1), a, b.

actions.purpose: Tightens a stroke to the defect's edges: at each sample the two strongest opposite-signed luminance edges inside the stroke bound the core. When to use: On a scratch, a tear or a thin defect a person marked roughly with a brush. When not to use: On a stain or an area (rasterize a box or a polygon), or where the defect has no edges (the stroke stays as drawn).
actions.title: Tighten

actions.name: apply

in.name: image
in.purpose: The canvas.

in.name: mask
in.purpose: The mask carrying the prescriptions.

out.name: image
out.purpose: The canvas with the prescriptions performed.

actions.purpose: The mask's prescriptions performed on the canvas, once each, in order. When to use: After ramp, to meet the two sides of a seam in colour before or instead of a filler; before paste in the heal graph. When not to use: On a mask without prescriptions (nothing to do; not applicable), or to paint a filler's result (use paste).
actions.title: Apply

actions.name: cut

strip.description: The strip fraction f in (0, 0.5]: s = min(max(2, 2·round_half_up(f·W/2)), 2·floor(W/4)).

in.name: image
in.purpose: A canonical or working image in a wrapped raw frame, at least 4 columns wide.

out.name: image
out.purpose: The canvas, in the cut frame.

out.name: plan
out.purpose: The strip width and the source spans, for put.

actions.purpose: The two edge strips of a wrapped image side by side, so its wrap edge is the centre column of a bounded canvas. When to use: Before any work on the wrap seam of an equirectangular image: the seam becomes an ordinary vertical line in the middle of a small canvas. When not to use: On a flat image, or on a frame that is already a cut canvas; and when the edit is not near the wrap edge.
actions.title: Cut

actions.name: put

in.name: image
in.purpose: The parent image, in the raw frame the plan was made for.

in.name: canvas
in.purpose: The canvas, in the cut frame.

in.name: plan
in.purpose: The plan cut produced.

out.name: image
out.purpose: The parent with the canvas put back.

actions.purpose: A cut canvas written back onto its parent image; nothing outside the two strips changes. When to use: After work on a cut canvas, to return to the full wrapped image. When not to use: When the canvas was not made from this parent by this plan: the sizes will not agree and put refuses.
actions.title: Put

actions.name: ramp

constants.description: The constant set; the first is the default: ramp-v1

ramp_sigma.description: Row smoothing of the step, as a fraction of the height.

share.description: The share of the step each side moves toward the other at the line.

in.name: image
in.purpose: The canvas the band was measured on.

in.name: mask
in.purpose: The band mask, with its profile.

out.name: mask
out.purpose: The mask with the prescription added.

actions.purpose: The per-row colour step across a band's line, as a tone-ramp prescription on the mask. When to use: After profile, on the canvas the band was measured on, so apply or the filler's composite can meet the two sides in colour at the line. When not to use: On a mask without a band profile (the step windows come from it), or when the sides already agree.
actions.title: Ramp

actions.name: unwindow

in.name: image
in.purpose: The parent image.

in.name: crop
in.purpose: The crop, in a crop: frame of the parent.

out.name: image
out.purpose: The parent with the crop written back.

actions.purpose: A crop written back into exactly its bbox of the parent image. When to use: After work on a windowed crop (a filler's composite, an apply), to return to the full image. When not to use: When the crop is not in a crop: frame of this parent: the frames will not agree and unwindow refuses.
actions.title: Unwindow

actions.name: window

constants.description: The constant set; the first is the default: window-v1

context.description: The context on each side of the support, as a share of its width and height.

max_side.description: The largest side of the window in pixels; a support larger than it is not applicable. Unset: no cap but the image.

in.name: image
in.purpose: The image to window.

in.name: mask
in.purpose: The mask whose support the window is built around.

out.name: image
out.purpose: The crop of the image, in the crop: frame.

out.name: mask
out.purpose: The mask's planes cropped by the same bbox, in the crop: frame.

actions.purpose: An integer crop around the mask's support, with context, as a new crop: frame holding the image and the mask. When to use: Before a filler whose max_side is smaller than the image, or to work on the region alone; the heal graph windows before the filler call and unwindows after. When not to use: When the support itself is larger than max_side (scaled windows are a later milestone), or when the whole frame is wanted.
actions.title: Window

actions.name: measure

constants.description: The constant set; the first is the default: measures-v1

set.description: The measures to run, comma-separated: continuity, tone_step, transition, texture_match, drift.

in.name: after
in.purpose: The image to measure (the composite).

in.name: before
in.purpose: The image before (for drift).

in.name: mask
in.purpose: The mask, with its profile for the band measures.

in.name: line
in.purpose: The line (column form) for continuity; the profile's column when absent.

out.name: continuity
out.purpose: The per-row `continuity` series (ratio); absent when the measure was not in the set, not applicable or measured nothing.

out.name: tone_step_dl
out.purpose: The per-row `tone_step.dL` series (L); absent when the measure was not in the set, not applicable or measured nothing.

out.name: tone_step_dchroma
out.purpose: The per-row `tone_step.dchroma` series (chroma); absent when the measure was not in the set, not applicable or measured nothing.

out.name: tone_step_dhue
out.purpose: The per-row `tone_step.dhue` series (degrees); absent when the measure was not in the set, not applicable or measured nothing.

out.name: transition
out.purpose: The per-row `transition` series (ratio); absent when the measure was not in the set, not applicable or measured nothing.

out.name: texture_match
out.purpose: The per-row `texture_match` series (ratio); absent when the measure was not in the set, not applicable or measured nothing.

actions.purpose: The seam and composite measures: continuity, tone step, transition, texture match and drift, per row and summarised. When to use: After a heal or a paste, on the before and after images in the mask's frame, to describe what changed at the line and what did not; none of them is a verdict. When not to use: On images of different frames or sizes (window or put first).
actions.title: Measure

actions.name: paste

constants.description: The constant set; the first is the default: poisson-v1

mode.description: feather: blend by the effective weight; hard: the fill where the core is set; poisson: the gradient-domain blend, then the feather of its solution.

in.name: base
in.purpose: The image to paste onto.

in.name: fill
in.purpose: The filler's result, in the same frame and size.

in.name: mask
in.purpose: The mask whose effective weight decides what is written.

out.name: image
out.purpose: The composite.

actions.purpose: A fill composited onto the base through the mask: feather blends by the effective weight, hard writes the core, poisson blends in the gradient domain. When to use: After a filler returns its result for the mask's frame, or after apply, to produce the composite; the last step of the heal graph before put. poisson when the fill's tone or level does not match the base at the mask's edge: it keeps the fill's gradients and takes its values from the base around the mask. When not to use: When the fill is not the mask's frame and size (window or put first); poisson on a wrap frame (cut the band first; the seam canvas is bounded) or on a mask whose every w > 0 pixel is cut off from the base (nothing to anchor to).
actions.title: Paste

actions.name: render

colour.description: tinted and overlay: the tint as #rrggbb; the default is a magenta no photograph has.

strength.description: tinted: how far the core moves toward the colour.

threshold.description: binary: 255 where w ≥ threshold / 255; protected pixels are 0 whatever it is.

in.name: mask
in.purpose: The mask to render.

in.name: image
in.purpose: The image to draw on, required by alpha, tinted and overlay; in the mask's frame.

out.name: image
out.purpose: The rendering.

actions.purpose: A mask rendered for one consumer; the record stays the truth. When to use: When a filler, a viewer or a test needs to see a mask as pixels: a grey weight map, a binary at a threshold, the photo tinted or cut out, or an overlay for the eye. When not to use: When an op needs the mask itself: a rendering is an Image and is never accepted where a Mask is declared. There is no protect rendering; a second pass uses invert.
actions.title: Render

actions.name: inspect

in.name: mask
in.purpose: The mask to inspect.

in.name: image
in.purpose: The image to draw the overlay on; in the mask's frame.

out.name: overlay
out.purpose: The overlay, an inspection image.

out.name: widths
out.purpose: The core's width per row, in pixels.

actions.purpose: A mask for the eye: the overlay on its image and the per-row width of its core. When to use: When a person wants to see what a mask covers and how its width varies row by row; the run page uses it too. When not to use: When a filler needs a rendering (use render), or when an op needs the mask itself.
actions.title: Inspect

artifact_types.purpose: Where something is in an image: a box, a polygon, a line, a stroke or the whole image.
A mask: what to change (core), how it fades (blend) and what to keep (protect), in the frame it was drawn in, with the band profile, sigmas and prescriptions it carries.
A band along a line: its half-width per row, wide on smooth surfaces and thin on detail, from which a mask is drawn.
Values along a mask or a line, one per row or sample (widths, sigmas, measures).
How a cut canvas maps back onto the image it was cut from: the strips and where each lies.

tool.name: rascal
tool.purpose: Finds, masks and composites regions of an image.
